Day 1
Islands
Day 1
Nosy Be

Welcome to the Perfume Island

Welcome to Nosy Be — Madagascar's famous Perfume Island, celebrated for its lush tropical landscapes, turquoise waters and vibrant island culture. You'll be met at the airport and transferred to your hotel on the island's scenic west coast overlooking Sakatia Island. Spend your first evening relaxing by the beach, watching the sunset or unwinding with a cocktail as you settle into the unhurried rhythm of island life.

Airport welcome & transferBeachfront hotel — Sakatia Island viewsSunset from the west coast beach
Your hotel on the west coast offers panoramic ocean views, tropical gardens and direct beach access — the perfect base for the next seven nights.
Days 2–7
Islands
Days 2–7
Nosy Be & Surrounding Islands

Islands at Your Own Pace

Enjoy several days at leisure to relax and explore the incredible natural beauty of Nosy Be and its surrounding islands. Each day can be shaped entirely around your interests — whether that's snorkelling on pristine reefs, visiting lemur sanctuaries, discovering secluded beaches or simply sitting in the shade with a cold drink. Your TMC guide will help you build each day as you go.

Complete flexibility — your pace, your choiceDay trips to surrounding islandsOptional excursions available dailyHotel pool, spa and beachfront dining
All optional tours can be arranged through your hotel or directly with TMC. Advance booking recommended for whale shark excursions (Oct–Dec).
Nosy Be Island Tour
Culture
Nosy Be Island Tour
Nosy Be

Discover the Island

A curated day exploring Nosy Be's highlights — fragrant ylang-ylang plantations, volcanic crater lakes at Mont Passot with panoramic views across to neighbouring islands, the island's sacred trees and colourful local markets. A perfect introduction to the island's culture and landscape for first-time visitors.

Mont Passot panoramic viewpointYlang-ylang & spice plantationsSacred lakes & treesLocal village markets
This tour typically runs in the morning. Comfortable walking shoes recommended for the market and village sections.
Nosy Komba
Wildlife
Nosy Komba
Nosy Komba

The Lemur Island

A short boat ride from Nosy Be brings you to Nosy Komba — the Island of Lemurs. Semi-wild black lemurs roam freely through protected forest and will approach you with remarkable confidence. After the forest walk, explore the beachfront village and browse the island's famous handicraft market, where local artisans sell silk, gemstones and handmade crafts.

Semi-wild black lemur encountersGuided forest walkTraditional village visitHandicraft market — silk, gemstones, crafts
Accessible by 20-minute speedboat from Nosy Be. Can be combined with Tanikely in a single full-day excursion.
Nosy Iranja
Marine
Nosy Iranja
Nosy Iranja

The Iconic Sandbar

One of Madagascar's most photographed and most magical destinations. Two small islands connected at low tide by a dazzling white sandbar stretching into impossibly turquoise water. Spend the day swimming in the crystal-clear lagoon, snorkelling on the fringing reef and relaxing on pristine beaches under palm trees. Lunch is served on the beach beneath the shade of a palm. An overnight stay is also available for those who want to experience the island after the day visitors leave.

Iconic twin-island sandbar at low tideCrystal-clear snorkelling lagoonFreshly prepared beach lunchOvernight option available
A 1.5-2 hour speedboat ride from Nosy Be depending on sea conditions. Best visited at low tide for the full sandbar experience.
Tanikely Reserve
Marine
Tanikely Reserve
Tanikely Marine Reserve

World-Class Snorkelling

Tanikely Marine Reserve is one of Madagascar's most beautiful protected areas — a small island ringed by exceptional coral reef teeming with tropical fish, rays and marine life. The snorkelling here is among the best in the Indian Ocean, with excellent visibility in calm, protected waters. After snorkelling, explore the island on foot to the historic lighthouse for panoramic views.

Protected coral reef snorkellingTropical fish, rays & marine lifeHistoric lighthouse & island walkExcellent visibility year-round
15 minutes by speedboat from Nosy Be. All snorkelling equipment provided. Suitable for all ages and experience levels.
Day 7
Marine
Day 7
Nosy Sakatia

Swimming with Sea Turtles

Your penultimate day is one of the most memorable of the week. Just west of Nosy Be lies Nosy Sakatia — a small, serene island known above all else for its resident population of green sea turtles. Guided by an experienced local marine guide, you’ll snorkel in the calm, crystal-clear bays where these graceful creatures feed and rest in their natural habitat. The encounters are close, respectful and utterly unhurried — very much in the mora mora spirit of the whole week. The coral gardens surrounding the island are also exceptional, with excellent visibility and abundant marine life throughout.

Green sea turtle snorkellingResident turtle populationVibrant coral gardensExpert local marine guide
Nosy Sakatia is a 10-minute boat transfer from your hotel. All snorkelling equipment is provided. Suitable for all experience levels including non-swimmers with a float vest.
Day 8
Departure
Day 8
Departure

Farewell to Nosy Be

After a final breakfast at your hotel, transfer to Nosy Be Airport for your departing flight. Take in one last view of the turquoise waters and lush tropical islands as you head home — carrying with you the unhurried warmth of Madagascar.

Final breakfast at your hotelAirport transfer included
Allow sufficient time for the transfer and check-in. Early morning departures can be arranged with advance notice.
